title: Stolen phone can't reconnect to transmitter?
body: I had my phone stolen and I can't get new phone to connect to sensor.i was wondering if there is any way to pair the new phone without having to use a new sensor?

comments.body: You should be able to pair any phone with the sensor. Make sure you have the transmitter id absolutely 1000% correct. I assume this is a question relating to G5 or G6

@siblues Would you please close this issue if it has already been resolved?
Thanks
